Dynamic OS libraries used by ksud are a separate case.

name: libres / dietlibc resolver (BusyBox)
evidence: ndk-busybox/libres/README identifies the dietlibc-derived resolver and Dan Drown's libres-0.32-1 adaptation; busybox_sources.cmake compiles its twelve C files. Distributed as part of the GPL-2.0-only BusyBox executable; no libres objects are linked into ksud.

name: GNU C Library helpers (BusyBox)
evidence: Compiled glibc-derived mntent_r.c, semctl.c, ether_aton_r.c and ether_ntoa_r.c retain LGPL-2.1-or-later grants. These are source copies in BusyBox, not the Android platform's C library. The overall BusyBox distribution remains GPL-2.0-only. Compiler inputs also include the glibc-derived scsi/scsi.h, scsi/sg.h and sys/kd.h; their notices are retained.

name: volume_id filesystem probes (BusyBox)
evidence: Compiled util-linux/volume_id sources retain Kay Sievers and other original notices; volume_id.c specifies LGPL-2.1-or-later. CONFIG_VOLUMEID is enabled. Per-file GPL/BSD/public-domain grants are retained in the notice snapshot; the overall BusyBox distribution remains GPL-2.0-only.

name: MatrixSSL code (BusyBox TLS)
evidence: BusyBox tls_pstm*.c and tls_rsa.c identify MatrixSSL 3.7.2b-derived code. Original GPL-2.0-or-later notices and GPLv2 BusyBox modifications are retained; CONFIG_TLS is enabled.

name: wolfSSL code (BusyBox TLS)
evidence: BusyBox networking/tls_fe.c incorporates wolfssl-3.15.3/wolfcrypt/src/fe_low_mem.c under its retained GPL-2.0-or-later notice, with GPLv2 BusyBox changes; it also identifies Daniel Beer's public-domain contribution.

name: tiny-AES128-C code (BusyBox TLS)
evidence: BusyBox networking/tls_aes.c retains the original tiny-AES128-C public-domain/Unlicense text and explicitly places the expanded BusyBox implementation under GPLv2. Do not describe the modified file as entirely public domain.

name: LZO / lzop (BusyBox)
evidence: busybox_sources.cmake compiles lzop.c and the lzo1x sources; liblzo.h identifies the lzo-2.03 import. The compiler dependency log also includes lzo1x_c.c directly. CONFIG_LZOP and CONFIG_LZOP_COMPR_HIGH are enabled; the overall BusyBox binary is GPL-2.0-only.

name: LZMA SDK decoder (BusyBox adaptation)
evidence: BusyBox decompress_unlzma.c identifies LzmaDecode.c from LZMA SDK 4.22 and explicitly licenses this adaptation GPLv2 or later. It is separate from the public-domain XZ Embedded decoder and the new 0BSD liblzma.

name: FreeSec DES crypt (BusyBox)
evidence: BusyBox libbb/pw_encrypt.c directly includes pw_encrypt_des.c; compiler dependency records confirm its use. The file retains David Burren's FreeSec BSD-3-Clause notice and FreeBSD adaptation attribution.

name: RSA MD5 / FreeBSD MD5 crypt (BusyBox)
evidence: BusyBox libbb/pw_encrypt.c directly includes pw_encrypt_md5.c. This is derived from the RSA Data Security, Inc. MD5 Message-Digest Algorithm and FreeBSD md5_crypt; the original RSA attribution requirement and Poul-Henning Kamp's Beerware notice are reproduced in full.
